adjudication.rationale: In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (email-manager.ts) the code conditionally notifies team members via `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`. However, `addGuestsHandler` constructs `evt: CalendarEvent` without setting any `team` field at all (it sets `organizer`, `attendees`, `destinationCalendar`, etc., but no `evt.team`). Therefore `calendarEvent.team` will be `undefined` and the team-member notification loop will never execute, so collective/round-robin/team bookings won’t notify team members of added guests as intended by the new email logic.
